title: Project Progress Desk: Know Where All Your Claude Code and Codex Projects Stand at a Glance
abstract: arXiv:2611.13287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Codex and Claude Code let developers work on many projects in parallel, but keeping track of them still means switching between chats, terminal sessions and providers. We present Project Progress Desk, a local desktop interface that brings overall progress, blockers and pending decisions into one view. Users can see which projects need attention, inspect what remains, and compare earlier approaches before choosing how to continue. Agent receipts link reported outcomes to each project's weighted acceptance checklist; the overview distinguishes receipt-supported progress from dated estimates. We describe daily use across 36 projects, including a choice between two implementations based on their recorded outcomes. At the demo, attendees will explore 30 simulated projects, trace completed work to overall progress, and watch a coding agent's new result update the overview.

translated_title: 项目进展台：一目了然地掌握你所有 Claude Code 和 Codex 项目的进展状态
translated_abstract: Codex 和 Claude Code 让开发者可以并行处理多个项目，但追踪这些项目仍需要在聊天窗口、终端会话和不同服务提供商之间来回切换。我们提出了 Project Progress Desk（项目进展台），这是一个本地桌面界面，将整体进展、阻塞项和待决事项汇集到一个视图中。用户可以看到哪些项目需要关注、检查剩余工作，并在决定如何继续之前比较此前的方案。智能体回执将报告的结果与每个项目的加权验收清单相关联；总览界面会区分由回执支持的进展与基于日期的估算。我们描述了在 36 个项目中的日常使用情况，包括根据记录的结果在两个实现方案之间做出选择。在演示环节，与会者将探索 30 个模拟项目，将已完成的工作追溯到整体进展，并观看编码智能体的新结果如何实时更新总览视图。
tldr: 该论文提出了 Project Progress Desk，一个本地桌面界面，将 Claude Code 和 Codex 多个并行项目的整体进展、阻塞项和待决事项汇集到统一视图中，并通过智能体回执将报告结果与加权验收清单关联，从而区分真实进展与估算进展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Project Progress Desk, a local desktop interface that consolidates the progress, blockers, and pending decisions of multiple parallel Claude Code and Codex projects into one unified view, using agent receipts to link reported outcomes to weighted acceptance checklists and distinguish receipt-supported progress from dated estimates.
